idealClarificationQuestions: Physical attendance at parades + flag hoisting + cultural events nationally? Yes.
Government + school + community events all combined? Yes.

calculationFlow: Schools: ~15 lakh schools, each with ~250 students avg attending flag hoisting = ~37 crore students attending school-based events.
Of these, actually attending (allowing for absentees on holiday): ~50% = ~18 crore.
Government / civic offices: ~50 lakh employees attending.
Public Republic Day parade Delhi (Kartavya Path): ~1 lakh ticketed + ~10 lakh public watching live nearby.
State capital RD events: 28 states × ~50K attendees each = ~14 lakh.
Local government / RWA / panchayat flag hoisting: ~5 lakh events × 100 people = ~5 crore.
Total physical attendance pan-India: ~22-25 crore Indians at some Republic Day event.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total physical attendance pan-India: ~22-25 crore Indians at some Republic Day event.
